items.title_zh: anthropics/claudes-c-compiler
items.summary: The repository contains a dependency-free C compiler written in Rust by Claude Opus 4.6, with x86 (64- and 32-bit), ARM and RISC-V backends, capable of compiling a booting Linux kernel.

items.summary: A Wiz blog post reports that an exposed Moltbook database revealed millions of API keys.

items.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.raw_content: Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.summary: Qwen published a blog post on Qwen3-Coder-Next; the page describes Qwen's broader feature set, including chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.raw_content: Chinese delivery platform Meituan said today it plans to acquire the China operations of fresh grocery e-commerce firm Dingdong Maicai for an initial
items.title_zh: Meituan 将以 7.17 亿美元收购生鲜电商 Dingdong Maicai
items.summary: Chinese delivery platform Meituan said it plans to acquire the China operations of fresh grocery e-commerce firm Dingdong Maicai for an initial $717 million.

items.summary: TikTok's 'addictive design' has been found to be illegal in Europe.

items.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.summary: Qwen published a blog post on Qwen3-Coder-Next; the page describes Qwen's broader feature set, including chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Animated Knots
items.title_zh: Animated Knots：动态图解打结教程
items.summary: Animated Knots is a site for learning to tie knots of many kinds, from boating, fishing and climbing knots to neckties and surgical knots.

items.title: Show HN: Wikipedia as a doomscrollable social media feed
items.title_zh: Show HN：把维基百科变成可以刷的社交媒体信息流
items.summary: Xikipedia presents Simple Wikipedia content as a pseudo social media feed, using a basic non-ML algorithm that runs locally and adapts to what a reader engages with; no data leaves the device and the site works offline once loaded.

items.title: Bunny Database
items.title_zh: Bunny Database：全球部署的 SQL 服务
items.summary: Bunny.net introduced Bunny Database, an SQL service that lets users deploy globally, query over HTTP and scale reads with low latency, pitched as a way to build fast without paying the serverless tax.

items.title: What's up with all those equals signs anyway?
items.title_zh: 那些等号究竟是怎么回事？
items.summary: The post responds to a recent wave of old email excerpts being shared on Twitter and asks what is behind the equals signs that appear in them.

items.title: FBI couldn't get into WaPo reporter's iPhone because Lockdown Mode enabled
items.title_zh: FBI 因 Lockdown Mode 无法解锁《华盛顿邮报》记者的 iPhone
items.summary: A court record indicates that Apple's Lockdown Mode might have stopped the FBI from unlocking a Washington Post reporter's iPhone, suggesting the feature can make devices harder for third parties to access — at least for now.

items.title: Ardour 9.0
items.title_zh: Ardour 9.0
items.summary: Ardour released version 9.0, which the project says brings new features, quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.

items.title: OpenClaw is what Apple intelligence should have been
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 才是 Apple Intelligence 应有的样子
items.summary: People are buying Mac Minis specifically to run AI agents with computer use, setting up headless machines whose sole job is to automate their workflows. OpenClaw, the open-source framework that lets Claude, GPT-5 or another model control a computer, has become the killer app for Mac hardware, the author argues.

items.title: I now assume that all ads on Apple news are scams
items.title_zh: 我现在认为 Apple News 上的广告全是骗局
items.summary: The author argues that many of the ads served in Apple News by Taboola are clearly scams.

items.title: Things Unix can do atomically (2010)
items.title_zh: Unix 能原子完成的事（2010）
items.summary: The article catalogs operations that Unix-like, POSIX-compliant operating systems can perform atomically, presented as building blocks for thread-safe and multi-process-safe programs without mutexes or read/write locks.

items.title: SectorC: A C Compiler in 512 bytes (2023)
items.title_zh: SectorC：512 字节的 C 编译器（2023）
items.summary: SectorC is a C compiler written in x86-16 assembly that fits inside the 512-byte boot sector of an x86 machine and supports a subset of C large enough for real programs.

items.title: AI fatigue is real and nobody talks about it
items.title_zh: AI 疲劳真实存在，却没人谈论
items.summary: A blog post argues that AI fatigue is real: engineers using AI to be more productive end up more exhausted, a paradox the author says they must confront.

items.title: I put a real-time 3D shader on the Game Boy Color
items.title_zh: 我在 Game Boy Color 上实现了实时 3D 着色器
items.summary: A developer made a Game Boy Color game that renders images in real time, with the player controlling an orbiting light and spinning an object; the look was first tested in Blender.

items.title: “Nothing” is the secret to structuring your work
items.title_zh: “留白”是安排工作的秘诀
items.summary: A blog post argues that “nothing” is the secret to structuring your work.

items.title: Guinea worm on track to be 2nd eradicated human disease; only 10 cases in 2025
items.title_zh: 麦地那龙线虫有望成为第二种被消灭的人类疾病，2025 年仅 10 例
items.summary: Guinea worm disease is on track to become the second human disease eradicated, with only 10 cases in 2025; when the eradication program began in 1986 there were 3.5 million cases.

items.title: The Waymo World Model
items.title_zh: Waymo 世界模型
items.summary: Waymo introduced the Waymo World Model, describing it as a frontier generative model that sets a new bar for large-scale, hyper-realistic autonomous driving simulation.

items.title: Meituan to acquire on-demand grocery firm Dingdong Maicai for $717 million
items.title_zh: Meituan 将以 7.17 亿美元收购生鲜电商 Dingdong Maicai
items.summary: Chinese delivery platform Meituan said it plans to acquire the China operations of fresh grocery e-commerce firm Dingdong Maicai for an initial $717 million.

items.title: Apple evaluates chip suppliers other than TSMC for first time in 12 years
items.title_zh: 苹果 12 年来首次评估台积电以外的芯片供应商
items.summary: Citing The Wall Street Journal, the report says Apple is weighing whether to move part of its low-end processor production from TSMC to alternative suppliers, the first time in 12 years it has evaluated other chip suppliers.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO says TSMC needs to double capacity in a decade to support historic infrastructure buildout
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO 称台积电需在十年内将产能翻倍，以支撑史上最大规模基建投资
items.summary: In an interview in Taiwan, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said TSMC would need to double its capacity within a decade to support what he called the largest infrastructure investment in human history.

items.title: Alibaba’s Qwen app launches $420 million Spring Festival campaign to promote AI-powered consumer experiences
items.title_zh: 阿里 Qwen App 推出 4.2 亿美元春节活动，推广 AI 消费体验
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen app on Monday announced a Spring Festival campaign worth RMB 3 billion ($420 million), with large free-order promotions intended to promote AI-powered consumer experiences.

items.title: When AI companions break free from Wi-Fi and step outside the home with Fuzozo
items.title_zh: 当 AI 伴侣摆脱 Wi-Fi、随 Fuzozo 走出家门
items.summary: TechNode reports that Fuzozo, an AI companion, appears to shift focus away from short-term novelty and toward a longer-term proposition, unlike products positioned more as AI toys.

items.title: Ford and Geely in talks on potential manufacturing and technology partnership
items.title_zh: 福特与吉利就潜在的制造与技术合作进行洽谈
items.summary: Ford and China's Geely are in talks over a potential manufacturing and technology partnership, as the two global automakers look to share rising costs.

items.title: XPeng Reportedly Merges Autonomous Driving and Smart Cockpit Units Into New General AI Center
items.title_zh: 小鹏据报将自动驾驶与智能座舱部门合并为新的通用 AI 中心
items.summary: XPeng has merged its autonomous driving center and smart cockpit center into a new General AI Center, according to sources familiar with the matter.

items.title: Vivo approves vlog camera project to rival DJI Pocket series
items.title_zh: Vivo 批准 Vlog 相机项目，对标 DJI Pocket 系列
items.summary: Vivo has approved an internal project to develop a vlog camera aimed at competing directly with DJI's Pocket series of portable imaging devices.

items.title: Chinese TV brands projected to reach 60% share in Japan market
items.title_zh: 中国电视品牌预计将占据日本市场 60% 份额
items.summary: Nikkei reports that Chinese television brands are projected to account for about 60% of Japan's domestic TV market, citing data from BCN Research.

items.title: Tencent invests in Neolix to boost L4 autonomous delivery in urban logistics
items.title_zh: 腾讯投资 Neolix，加码城市物流 L4 自动驾驶配送
items.summary: Tencent has taken a stake in autonomous delivery vehicle maker Neolix, according to China's national corporate credit information publicity system.

items.title: anthropics/claudes-c-compiler
items.title_zh: anthropics/claudes-c-compiler
items.summary: The repository contains a dependency-free C compiler written in Rust by Claude Opus 4.6, with x86 (64- and 32-bit), ARM and RISC-V backends, capable of compiling a booting Linux kernel.

items.title: GCWing/OpenBitFun
items.title_zh: GCWing/OpenBitFun：Rust 编写的高性能智能体运行时与桌面应用
items.summary: OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a desktop application, pairing Code Agent capabilities with open, general-purpose use beyond software development.

items.title: MengTo/Skills
items.title_zh: MengTo/Skills：面向设计师与构建者的智能体技能集
items.summary: Skills aimed at designers and builders who work with Codex, Claude, Cursor and similar AI coding tools; the repository is primarily HTML.

items.title: fspecii/ace-step-ui
items.title_zh: fspecii/ace-step-ui
items.summary: An open-source Suno alternative offering a professional UI for ACE-Step 1.5 AI music generation that runs free and locally without limits.

items.title: ilysenko/codex-desktop-linux
items.title_zh: ilysenko/codex-desktop-linux
items.summary: An unofficial ChatGPT desktop app for Linux, formerly the Codex app, built locally from OpenAI's official macOS app. It includes Chat, Work and Codex, with packages for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora/openSUSE, Arch, Nix/NixOS and AppImage, plus Wayland and X11 support.

items.title: htdt/godogen
items.title_zh: htdt/godogen：用 Claude Code 与 Codex 自主开发游戏
items.summary: A Python project for autonomous game development using Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: withastro/flue
items.title_zh: withastro/flue：沙箱智能体框架
items.summary: Flue is described as a sandbox agent framework written in TypeScript.

items.title: sumelabs/clawra
items.title_zh: sumelabs/clawra
items.summary: Clawra is a TypeScript project that presents OpenClaw as a companion.

items.title: stupside/castor
items.title_zh: stupside/castor
items.summary: castor is a Go tool that takes any web page, finds its video, transcodes it and streams it to a TV in real time, burning in subtitles.

items.title: GRP-Obliteration: Unaligning LLMs With a Single Unlabeled Prompt
items.title_zh: GRP-Obliteration：用单条无标注提示解除 LLM 对齐
items.summary: The authors introduce GRP-Obliteration (GRP-Oblit), which uses Group Relative Policy Optimization to remove safety constraints from aligned models with a single unlabeled prompt while largely preserving utility. They report stronger unalignment on average than existing state-of-the-art methods across fifteen 7-20B models from families including GPT-OSS, distilled DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Ministral and Qwen, and show the approach also works on diffusion-based image generation systems.

items.title: Is my model "mind blurting"? Interpreting the dynamics of reasoning tokens with Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA)
items.title_zh: 我的模型在“mind blurting”吗？用递归量化分析（RQA）解读推理 token 的动态
items.summary: The authors propose Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA) as a non-textual way to study reasoning chains at test time, treating token generation as a dynamical system and extracting hidden embeddings at each generation step. Analyzing 3,600 generation traces from DeepSeek-R1-Distill, they find RQA captures signals that response length misses and improves prediction of task complexity by 8%.

items.title: A Multi-scale Linear-time Encoder for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
items.title_zh: 用于全切片图像分析的多尺度线性时间编码器
items.summary: MARBLE is a purely Mamba-based, multi-state multiple instance learning framework that processes several magnification levels in parallel for whole-slide image analysis, reporting gains of up to 6.9% in AUC, 20.3% in accuracy and 2.3% in C-index across five public datasets.

items.title: Principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks
items.title_zh: 神经网络中的 Lipschitz 连续性原理
items.summary: The thesis studies Lipschitz continuity in neural networks from two angles: how it evolves during training and how it shapes the propagation of frequency signals relative to input features.

items.title: D-Legion: A Scalable Many-Core Architecture for Accelerating Matrix Multiplication in Quantized LLMs
items.title_zh: D-Legion：加速量化 LLM 矩阵乘法的可扩展多核架构
items.summary: D-Legion is a scalable many-core architecture built from adaptive-precision systolic array cores, organized into Legions, to accelerate matrix multiplication in quantized LLMs with support for sparse and dense modes and parallel accumulators that reduce partial-sum memory traffic. On attention workloads from two BitNet models it reports up to 8.2x lower latency and up to 3.8x higher memory savings than state-of-the-art work, with a 64-core configuration reaching 135.68 TOPS at 1 GHz.

items.title: All-Optical Segmentation via Diffractive Neural Networks for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 面向自动驾驶的衍射神经网络全光分割
items.summary: The authors propose an all-optical computing framework based on diffractive optical neural networks for RGB image segmentation and lane detection in autonomous driving, testing it on CityScapes, a custom indoor track and CARLA simulations.

items.title: Variance-Gated Ensembles: An Epistemic-Aware Framework for Uncertainty Estimation
items.title_zh: 方差门控集成：一种认知感知的不确定性估计框架
items.summary: The paper proposes Variance-Gated Ensembles, a differentiable framework that injects epistemic sensitivity through a signal-to-noise gate computed from ensemble statistics. It introduces a margin uncertainty score and a normalization layer for training, and reports matching or exceeding information-theoretic baselines while remaining computationally efficient.

items.title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models
items.title_zh: 从随机矩阵理论视角看扩散模型的一致性
items.summary: The authors build a random matrix theory framework showing how finite datasets shape the expectation and variance of learned denoisers and sampling maps, explaining why diffusion models trained on disjoint data splits yield similar outputs and identifying anisotropy, input inhomogeneity and dataset size as drivers of disagreement.
